close_reason: Decision B (rework framing). check_shape API stays; surrounding docs/PR text scrubbed of OSCAL framing. Folds into .12-style audit for .9.x doc comments. Applied under PKIX-ncab.7.
description:
PKIX-9vnx.9 was framed under the OSCAL Lint-as-Control mapping. `check_shape()` is a user-facing convenience API; per-profile aliases let users import `TlsBrLint` etc. without OSCAL vocabulary in their face.

Decide whether the convenience API stands on its own merits or was tied to OSCAL framing:

- **A) Keep as-is**; the convenience layer is independent of whether OSCAL is canonical.
- **B) Rework framing** in docs and PR descriptions; ship with no OSCAL references in user-facing text.
- **C) Close**; convenience API was overkill once OSCAL centrality is gone.

Note: PKIX-9vnx.9.2 (workspace-dep design call) is currently human-labeled and was the last blocker before demotion.

Decision-gate bead. Human label inherited from parent.
title: Decide fate of PKIX-9vnx.9 (check_shape API + per-profile aliases)
